paragraphs.text: Mileva , "the Stalwart," is a competent soldier on Ravnica who has been promoted several times.

Mileva is a proud, strong, and skilled soldier who has become a local hero in the Tenth District , her home. She has auburn hair and blue eyes and wears her armor whenever she is on duty. She appears to be ambidextrous, seen wielding weapons in either hand as well as dual-wielding weapons in battle.

Mileva served as a guard in the Tenth District around 10,076 ZC . The Tenth had always been her home, and the city was constantly embroiled in one crisis or another, but she was determined to protect her piece.

During the War of the Spark , Mileva received a Battlefield Promotion and became a Tenth District Legionnaire . The Tenth was under heavy attack by Eternals , but Tajic sent Mileva to defend her home.

Sometime after the Invasion, she began working with the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations , and during the Murders at Karlov Manor , Mileva became a detective , although she still wore her Boros uniform.
